newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sets rail auctions, to sell port terminal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets rail auctions, to sell port terminal.

text.p: Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) set December 4 for the sale of the Western Rail System with a minimum price of 25.684 million reais, said the privatization chief of the National Development Bank (BNDES).
Jose Pio Borges said five percent of the price would have to be paid in cash with the rest spread over 109 instalments, with a two-year grace period.

The Western Rail System auction will be followed December 13 by the sale of the Southern Network. Pio Borges said the privatization of the Western Rail System followed a request from Parana state governor Jaime Lerner.
The BNDES privatization chief also said the sale of Santos port, Brazil's biggest, would be on the agenda at the next CND meeting December 17.

He said container terminals at Santos and container, grains and coal terminals at Sepetiba port in Rio de Janeiro would be sold at auction and a technical working group had been set up to define the sales.
Tender details were excpected by year-end, he said.
